svg.title: How AlphaCode turns a goal into a verified result
svg.desc: Animated diagram of AlphaCode's agent loop. A goal enters on the left and passes through nine numbered steps: goal, context, plan, reason, safety check, act, observe, verify, report. If verification fails the loop returns to the reason step. Below the loop, the Rust agent core sits at the center. On its left are the systems that tell it what it knows: system prompt, project analyzer, code search, and sessions with memory. On its right are the systems that let it act: model router, tools, swarm, and the safety harness.
svg.text: How a goal becomes a verified result
AlphaCode’s agent loop: understand, plan, act, check, and only then report.
